description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Reservoir Engineering topic must state. facts.claim: Permeability is the ability of rock to let fluids flow

facts.claim: Water saturation is the fraction of pore volume filled with water

source.quote: the water saturation or degree of saturation
It is the ratio of the effective permeability of that phase to the absolute permeability

facts.claim: Dry gas is mostly methane; wet gas has heavier hydrocarbons

source.quote: Gas containing larger quantities of heavier hydrocarbons is generally described as “wet” gas, while gas consisting predominantly of methane is described as “dry” gas

facts.claim: Gas–oil ratio: gas volume per oil volume at standard conditions

source.quote: The gas/oil ratio (GOR) is the ratio of the volume of gas ("scf") that comes out of solution to the volume of oil

facts.claim: Z-factor corrects the ideal gas law for real gases

source.quote: It is a useful thermodynamic property for modifying the ideal gas law to account for the real gas behaviour

facts.claim: Oil in place = rock volume × porosity × oil saturation (÷ Bo)

source.quote: The oil in place is calculated as the product of the volume of porous oil-bearing rock, the porosity of the rock, and its saturation

facts.claim: Material balance: what enters either leaves or accumulates

source.quote: The mass that enters a system must, by conservation of mass, either leave the system or accumulate within the system

facts.claim: Decline curves predict future production from past history

source.quote: Decline curve analysis is a means of predicting future oil well or gas well production based on past production history

facts.claim: Water injection maintains pressure and sweeps oil

source.quote: water is injected into the oil reservoir, to maintain the pressure (also known as voidage replacement), or to drive oi

facts.claim: EOR (tertiary recovery) follows primary and secondary recovery

source.quote: Enhanced oil recovery (abbreviated EOR), also called tertiary recovery

facts.claim: Thermal, gas (including CO₂) and chemical methods

source.quote: There are four main EOR techniques: carbon dioxide (CO2) injection, gas injection, thermal EOR, and chemical EOR

facts.claim: Well tests measure flow rate and pressure to characterise the reservoir

source.quote: Data gathered during the test period includes volumetric flow rate and pressure observed in the selected well
